cbi.title: Citizenship by Investment
cbi.p1: Getting a second citizenship gives you and your family the legal right to hold an extra passport. This opens up doors for easy global travel without needing visas ahead of time. It also protects your personal assets and helps you manage your taxes in a smart, legal way. We guide you through approved government programs in the Caribbean and Pacific from start to finish, ensuring your application is safe, quick, and completely clear of stress.
cbi.p2: Our team handles all paperwork, background checks, and official submissions so you do not have to worry about complicated rules. Whether you want better security for your family or smoother business travel around the world, our citizenship desk makes the entire journey smooth and transparent.
cbi.dominicaDesc: Safe and peaceful Caribbean island offering straightforward legal passport processing without travel or language tests.
cbi.kittsDesc: The oldest and most trusted citizenship by investment program in the world, active since 1984 with dependable asset security.
cbi.antiguaDesc: The best and most cost-effective passport solution for large families, covering up to four members under one baseline fee.
cbi.luciaDesc: Flexible financial options with government-guaranteed bond investments that are 100% refundable after 5 years.
cbi.grenadaDesc: Powerful second passport providing direct qualification to apply for the USA E-2 Investor Visa to live and conduct business in America.
cbi.vanuatuDesc: The fastest legal citizenship pathway worldwide, delivered in 45 days with 100% remote processing.
cbi.saotomeDesc: Exclusive African island destination offering complete privacy, tax efficiency, and quiet citizenship by investment routes.
cbi.nauruDesc: Peaceful Pacific island citizenship offering zero residency requirements and straightforward remote management from Dubai.

rbi.title: Residency by Investment
rbi.p1: Residency and Golden Visa programs allow you to live, work, and study in amazing countries like Portugal, Greece, Panama, and the UAE. Having a legal residence card gives you the freedom to move across borders easily while enjoying high living standards and great tax benefits.
rbi.p2: We help you choose the best residency option based on your lifestyle and business goals. Our experts prepare all legal documents, book your appointments, and assist you right through until your residency card and local ID are safely delivered into your hands.
rbi.portugalDesc: European residency through regulated fund investments with a minimal 7 days per year stay requirement leading to EU citizenship.
rbi.greeceDesc: Permanent European residence cards and Schengen zone access granted through vetted real estate acquisitions.
rbi.panamaDesc: International banking hub offering rapid permanent residency and complete offshore corporate tax exemptions.
rbi.uaeDesc: Secure 10-year residency for you and your family with zero personal income tax, world-class infrastructure, and direct Dubai clearing lanes.

uaeGolden.title: UAE 10-Year Golden Visa
uaeGolden.p1: The UAE Golden Visa gives investors, entrepreneurs, and skilled professionals the right to live in Dubai for 10 long years without needing a local sponsor. It is one of the most popular long-term residency options in the world because of Dubai's safe environment, top-notch schools, and zero personal income tax.
uaeGolden.p2: Our office in Business Bay, Dubai works directly with government authorities and the Dubai Land Department. We handle your property evaluations, medical test bookings, and Emirates ID paperwork quickly so you get your visa approved with zero hassle.

realEstate.title: Prime Real Estate Advisory
realEstate.p1: Investing in real estate is one of the smartest ways to grow your wealth while securing a path to residency. We help you find luxury apartments, villas, and commercial properties in Dubai and top European cities that give you high rental profits and long-term value.
realEstate.p2: Before you buy any property, our legal team checks all land titles, builder histories, and payment plans to make sure your money is 100% safe. We make property buying simple, clear, and profitable for every investor.

education.title: Educational Advisory
education.p1: Giving your children the best education opens up a bright future for them. We help families secure student placements in top boarding schools and famous universities across the UK, Europe, and America.
education.p2: By pairing your university applications with a second citizenship or global residency, your children can qualify for local domestic tuition rates, saving you a large amount of money on school fees. Our educational advisors take care of test preparation, school tours, and admission forms from start to finish.

realEstate.faq_q1: Is Sharif Group officially licensed for real estate brokerage in Dubai?
realEstate.faq_a1: Yes, Sharif Group operates through its licensed real estate entity regulated by the Dubai Land Department (DLD Licence No. 1104715, RERA ORN 32517) for buying, selling, and leasing brokerage.
realEstate.faq_q2: What types of Dubai properties does Sharif Group advise on?
realEstate.faq_a2: Sharif Group specializes in curated off-plan and new launches, luxury ready homes and villas in established communities, and high-yield commercial/income-generating assets.
realEstate.faq_q3: Can foreign nationals buy property in Dubai?
realEstate.faq_a3: Yes, foreign nationals of any nationality can purchase 100% freehold property in designated investment zones across Dubai without needing a UAE residence visa.
realEstate.faq_q4: How does the UAE Golden Visa work for property buyers?
realEstate.faq_a4: Purchasing property worth AED 2,000,000 or more qualifies you and your family for a 10-year renewable UAE Golden Visa.
realEstate.faq_q5: Are there any property or rental taxes in Dubai?
realEstate.faq_a5: No, Dubai offers zero tax on property ownership, zero tax on rental income, and zero capital gains tax.
realEstate.faq_q6: What are the average rental yields in Dubai?
realEstate.faq_a6: Investors can earn strong net rental returns averaging between 6% to 9% depending on the location and property type.
realEstate.faq_q7: Can I buy off-plan property with a payment plan?
realEstate.faq_a7: Yes, most off-plan launches feature flexible installment payment plans linked to construction milestones directly from developers.
realEstate.faq_q8: Are off-plan payments safe in Dubai?
realEstate.faq_a8: Yes, all off-plan funds must be deposited into government-regulated escrow accounts monitored strictly by the Dubai Land Department.
realEstate.faq_q9: Can I manage my property purchase remotely?
realEstate.faq_a9: Yes, international investors can complete purchases securely from abroad using digital contracts, bank transfers, and an optional power of attorney.
realEstate.faq_q10: What documents do I need to buy a property?
realEstate.faq_a10: You only need a clear copy of your valid passport, contact details, and proof of address to reserve and register your property.
realEstate.faq_q11: Can I sponsor my family with a Golden Visa?
realEstate.faq_a11: Yes, property Golden Visa holders can sponsor their legal spouse, children of any age, and domestic staff.
realEstate.faq_q12: Do I need to live in Dubai to keep my Golden Visa?
realEstate.faq_a12: No minimum stay is required. Your 10-year residency remains active even if you live outside the UAE for extended periods.
realEstate.faq_q13: What are the extra closing fees when buying property?
realEstate.faq_a13: Standard fees include a 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) transfer fee, registration trustee fees, and modest administrative charges.
realEstate.faq_q14: Can foreigners get a mortgage in Dubai?
realEstate.faq_a14: Yes, non-resident foreign investors can qualify for mortgages in Dubai, typically up to 50% of the property value subject to bank approval.
realEstate.faq_q15: Which developers does Sharif Group partner with?
realEstate.faq_a15: We work directly with top master developers including Emaar, Meraas, Dubai Holding, Omniyat, and Jumeirah Living.
realEstate.faq_q16: What is the difference between off-plan and ready properties?
realEstate.faq_a16: Off-plan properties are under construction with flexible payment schedules, while ready properties are completed and available for immediate move-in or rental.
realEstate.faq_q17: Can Sharif Group help me rent out my property later?
realEstate.faq_a17: Yes, we provide full post-acquisition support including tenant finding, lease management, and property resale advisory.

realEstate.faq_a18: Our private advisory office is located at Suite 116, The Binary Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

education.faqA1: We provide complete educational guidance. This includes academic profiling, boarding school placement in the UK and Switzerland, undergraduate and postgraduate university admissions across Europe, UCAS application management, and full student visa filing.
education.faqA2: For top UK and Swiss boarding schools, we recommend starting 12 to 24 months before your intended start date. For undergraduate and master's degree programs, starting 12 months ahead gives you enough time for exam preparation and visa processing.
education.faqA3: Yes. Countries like Germany, the Netherlands, France, and Italy offer hundreds of fully accredited Bachelor's and Master's degrees taught completely in English across business, engineering, medicine, and computer science.
education.faqA4: Boarding schools accept students between the ages of 7 and 18. Main entry points are at Prep School level (ages 7 to 11), Senior School (ages 11 and 13), and Sixth Form (age 16 for A-Levels or IB).
education.faqA5: Public universities in countries like Germany and the Netherlands have lower tuition fees, ranging from €2,000 to €15,000 per year. In the UK, international university tuition ranges between £18,000 and £38,000 per academic year.
education.faqA6: Yes. Our advisory team helps students draft, structure, and refine their UCAS personal statements, motivation letters, and academic CVs so they meet the standards required by top admissions officers.
education.faqA7: Yes. We manage the entire visa process, including UK Child Student and Student visas, Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) verification, financial proof compliance, and European long-stay student residence permits.
education.faqA8: Yes. Families can schedule one-on-one meetings at our office in The Binary Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, for customized academic assessments and step-by-step guidance.
education.faqA9: UK visa rules require applicants to show proof of tuition fees plus living costs. These funds must be held in a bank account under the student or parent's name for a continuous 28-day period before applying.
education.faqA10: A blocked account is a mandatory bank account required by German immigration authorities. It holds the required annual living expenses to prove that the student can support themselves during their studies in Germany.
education.faqA11: To get started, you will need the student's passport, school transcripts from the last 2 to 3 years, English proficiency test scores (if required), and any graduation or diploma certificates.
education.faqA12: Yes. We arrange mock interview sessions and assessment coaching to help students build confidence, communicate effectively, and answer technical or subject-specific questions.
education.faqA13: Not always. While many institutions require IELTS, TOEFL, or Duolingo scores, some universities accept students who completed their high school education in an English-medium curriculum.
education.faqA14: Yes. For students under 18 studying at UK and Swiss boarding schools, institutions require an appointed local guardian residing in the country to provide emergency care and travel support.
education.faqA15: Yes. Most university student visas allow students to work part-time up to 20 hours per week during term time and full-time during official university holiday periods.
education.faqA16: The UK offers a 2-year Graduate Route visa for Bachelor's and Master's graduates. Germany and the Netherlands offer 12 to 18-month job-seeker visas to search for work in their fields.
education.faqA17: Yes. We help families secure on-campus boarding allocations, university halls of residence, or verified student apartments near campus before departure.
education.faqA18: We review the specific conditions (such as final exam scores or missing certificates), help you prioritize choices, and ensure all conditions are fulfilled before the deadline.
education.faqA19: Yes. For students under 12 attending day or boarding schools in the UK, one parent can apply for a Parent of a Child Student visa to live in the UK during their studies.

socialResp.focus_areas_item2: Key Pillars of Our Community Support.
socialResp.focus_areas_item3: We structure our social responsibility efforts across eight dedicated pillars to deliver clear, transparent, and direct support. Hover over any area to explore our initiatives.
socialResp.focus_areas_item7: Education is the strongest foundation for personal growth and lasting community progress. We provide financial grants, academic fellowships, and classroom resources to talented students from diverse backgrounds. Many bright minds face financial barriers that stop them from finishing their higher university degrees. Our continuous educational programs remove these money worries so students can focus completely on scientific research, mathematics, and technological innovation. By investing in young scholars today, we help build capable future leaders who will solve real problems in society tomorrow.
socialResp.focus_areas_item13: Families going through unexpected economic crisis require immediate, dependable, and compassionate support. We supply basic food packages, clean drinking water, essential clothing, and urgent household assistance directly to those who need it most. Our dedicated teams work alongside trusted local partners to locate households that are struggling under severe financial distress. We believe no family should ever have to choose between basic daily nutrition and keeping a safe roof over their heads. This practical aid brings immediate relief, restores human dignity, and provides long-term stability during their hardest times.
socialResp.focus_areas_item18: Good physical and mental health is an essential right that every individual deserves regardless of background. We sponsor critical medical treatments, essential prescription medicines, and routine health checks for underprivileged communities. Our efforts also support wellness awareness camps, mental wellbeing guidance, and clean hygiene supplies for children and elderly individuals. By partnering with qualified medical practitioners, we ensure that necessary health services reach remote and neglected areas quickly. Caring for the wellbeing of people creates stronger, happier, and much more resilient communities.
socialResp.focus_areas_item23: When natural disasters or sudden regional emergencies occur, rapid response and direct action save human lives. We mobilize emergency funds to deliver dry food rations, clean drinking water, warm blankets, and temporary shelter. Our operational network coordinates with frontline relief organizations to ensure help arrives where damage is most severe. We focus not only on emergency response during the first few days, but also on helping families rebuild their daily lives after the disaster passes. Providing dependable humanitarian aid is our ongoing promise to protect vulnerable human lives.
socialResp.focus_areas_item28: Strong neighborhoods grow when people have access to safe shared spaces and reliable local resources. We support the development of community centers, public libraries, clean recreation grounds, and neighborhood facilities. These locations give children safe areas to play and provide adults with spaces to learn, collaborate, and organize community meetings. We work closely with local representatives to make sure every project matches the genuine needs of residents. Building better local infrastructure creates a long-lasting environment where families thrive with safety and pride.
socialResp.focus_areas_item33: Young people hold incredible potential when given proper guidance, practical skills, and clear opportunities. We organize structured mentorship programs, vocational workshops, computer literacy sessions, and career counseling courses. These training programs teach practical modern skills that help young adults secure steady employment or start their own small businesses. We also encourage youth leadership activities that inspire confidence, teamwork, and active civic participation. Empowering our youth gives them the tools to build their own independent future and uplift their entire household.
socialResp.focus_areas_item38: Art, tradition, and cultural dialogue bring communities together and foster deep mutual respect among people. We sponsor historical preservation projects, community art workshops, book fairs, and intercultural dialogue programs. These events celebrate diverse cultural backgrounds while highlighting shared human values and peaceful coexistence. We believe preserving historical identity and creative expression keeps societies grounded and connected across generations. Supporting inclusive cultural programs builds bridges of friendship and creates richer, more peaceful communities for everyone.
socialResp.focus_areas_item43: Protecting nature and our natural resources is vital for the health and safety of future generations. We encourage energy conservation, paperless digital workflows, active plastic recycling, and responsible waste management. Beyond internal corporate measures, we support tree plantation drives, clean water protection projects, and green energy education programs. We believe small, mindful daily actions build the foundation for a much cleaner and healthier living environment. Taking direct responsibility for our planet ensures sustainable resources and cleaner surroundings for everyone.

dominica.faqDesc: Clear and comprehensive answers regarding all global migration regulations
dominica.faqQ1: What is the minimum investment for Dominica citizenship?
dominica.faqA1: The minimum investment for a single applicant starts at $200,000 USD via the Economic Diversification Fund (EDF) contribution, or $200,000 USD through pre-approved real estate (plus relevant government fees).
dominica.faqQ2: How long does it take to get a Dominica passport?
dominica.faqA2: The complete processing timeline typically takes between 6 to 9 months from document submission to the official issuance of your Naturalisation Certificate and passport.
dominica.faqQ3: Do I need to visit or live in Dominica to apply?
dominica.faqA3: No, the entire process is 100% remote. There are zero physical residency or arrival requirements before, during, or after your citizenship is granted.
dominica.faqQ4: Which family members can I include in my application?
dominica.faqA4: You can include your legal spouse, dependent children under 30 (studying full-time), unmarried daughters under 25, dependent parents/grandparents over 65, and financially dependent unmarried siblings under 25.
dominica.faqQ5: What is the Economic Diversification Fund (EDF)?
dominica.faqA5: The EDF is a non-refundable sovereign government fund used to finance national public infrastructure, healthcare, education, and economic development initiatives in Dominica.
dominica.faqQ6: How does the Real Estate investment route work?
dominica.faqA6: You invest a minimum of $200,000 USD in government-approved real estate, such as luxury resort shares or eco-villas, which must be held for a mandatory period of 3 to 5 years before reselling.
dominica.faqQ7: Is dual citizenship allowed under Dominica law?
dominica.faqA7: Yes, Dominica fully permits dual citizenship. The government does not require you to renounce your current nationality, and file confidentiality is strictly maintained.
dominica.faqQ8: Is there a mandatory interview for applicants?
dominica.faqA8: Yes, a mandatory virtual or in-person interview is required for the main applicant and all dependants aged 16 and older as part of standard due diligence procedures ($1,000 USD per person).
dominica.faqQ9: What are the due diligence fees for Dominica CBI?
dominica.faqA9: Government due diligence costs $7,500 USD for the main applicant and $4,000 USD for each dependant aged 16 and above. Specific enhanced background checks may apply based on nationality.
dominica.faqQ10: How many countries can I travel to visa-free with a Dominica passport?
dominica.faqA10: A Dominica passport provides visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry to over 130 to 140 countries, including European Schengen nations, Hong Kong, Singapore, and key Latin American destinations.
dominica.faqQ11: Is the citizenship permanent and valid for life?
dominica.faqA11: Yes, Dominica citizenship is granted for life through an official Certificate of Naturalisation, which is legally protected and can be passed down to future generations.
dominica.faqQ12: Are there any language or education tests required?
dominica.faqA12: No, there are no mandatory language proficiency exams, history tests, or specific educational background qualifications required to apply.
dominica.faqQ13: Can I submit my application directly to the government?
dominica.faqA13: No, the Dominica Citizenship by Investment Unit (CBIU) only accepts applications submitted through licensed authorized promoters like Sharif Group.
dominica.faqQ14: What are the tax advantages of Dominica citizenship?
dominica.faqA14: Dominica non-residents enjoy zero tax on worldwide income, wealth, gift, inheritance, or capital gains, offering a favorable financial structure for global investors.
dominica.faqQ15: What personal documents are needed to apply?
dominica.faqA15: Key documents include passport copies, birth & civil certificates, police clearance records, address proof, medical health reports, bank reference letters, and legal proof of source of funds.
dominica.faqQ16: Do I pay the main investment before or after approval?
dominica.faqA16: You only pay the primary investment amount (donation or real estate balance) after receiving official written Approval-in-Principle from the government unit.
dominica.faqQ17: How long can I stay in the UK with a Dominica passport?
dominica.faqA17: Dominica passport holders can stay in the United Kingdom for up to 6 months per visit for business or leisure purposes.
dominica.faqQ18: How do I renew my Dominica passport when it expires?
dominica.faqA18: Passports can be renewed easily through any official Dominica embassy/consulate globally, or directly through Sharif Group's Dubai office without traveling to Dominica.
dominica.faqQ19: Can newborn children be added after citizenship is issued?
dominica.faqA19: Yes, newborn children born after citizenship is obtained can be registered for citizenship by descent through a straightforward administrative filing.
dominica.faqQ20: Why should I apply through Sharif Group in Dubai?
dominica.faqA20: Sharif Group provides dedicated pre-vetting, end-to-end document clearance, transparent pricing, and lifetime support from our registered office in Business Bay, Dubai.

stlucia.faq_p1: Everything you need to know about getting Saint Lucia Citizenship
stlucia.faqQ1: What is the minimum cost for Saint Lucia citizenship?
stlucia.faqQ2: How long does the application process take?
stlucia.faqA1: The minimum contribution starts at $240,000 USD via the National Economic Fund (NEF) donation route, which covers a single applicant or a main applicant with up to three qualifying family dependants. Additional administrative, processing, and due diligence statutory fees apply depending on your overall family structure.
stlucia.faqQ3: Do I need to travel or reside in Saint Lucia to obtain citizenship?
stlucia.faqA2: The entire process typically takes approximately 3 to 4 months (~90 days) from the date your complete application is lodged with the Citizenship by Investment Unit (CIU). Once government background checks are approved, investment funds are remitted and your official citizenship certificates and passports are issued.
stlucia.faqQ4: What are the four main investment options available?
stlucia.faqA3: No, Saint Lucia does not require any physical residency before, during, or after your citizenship application. You are not required to visit or reside in Saint Lucia to maintain your status, allowing you to complete the entire process remotely from our Dubai advisory office.
stlucia.faqQ5: Which family members can be included in my application?
stlucia.faqA4: Saint Lucia offers four distinct routes: a non-refundable contribution to the National Economic Fund (NEF) from $240,000, National Action Government Bonds (NAB) from $300,000 held for 5 years, government-approved luxury Real Estate from $300,000, or approved Enterprise Projects starting from $3,500,000 for sole investors.
stlucia.faqQ6: What is the National Economic Fund (NEF)?
stlucia.faqA5: You can include your legal spouse, dependent children up to 21 years old (or up to 30 if enrolled full-time in higher education), physically/mentally challenged children of any age, financially dependent parents over 55, and unmarried siblings under the age of 18 with parental consent.
stlucia.faqQ7: How does the National Action Government Bond (NAB) option work?
stlucia.faqA6: The NEF is an official government financial fund established under Section 33 of the Citizenship by Investment Act. It finances sovereign infrastructure projects, healthcare facilities, education systems, and local economic growth initiatives across Saint Lucia.
stlucia.faqQ8: Can I qualify by investing in Saint Lucia Real Estate?
stlucia.faqA7: Under the NAB route, applicants purchase non-interest-bearing government bonds starting at $300,000 USD, accompanied by a $50,000 USD non-refundable administration fee. The bonds are held in the investor’s name for a mandatory period of 5 years, after which the initial capital is fully returned by the government.
stlucia.faqQ9: Does Saint Lucia allow dual citizenship?
stlucia.faqA8: Yes, you can qualify by acquiring government-approved real estate—typically luxury beachfront resorts, villas, or high-end hotel developments—with a minimum investment of $300,000 USD. Property assets must be retained for at least 5 years before they can be resold.
stlucia.faqQ10: What tax advantages does Saint Lucia citizenship offer?
stlucia.faqA9: Yes, Saint Lucia fully recognizes dual citizenship under sovereign law. You are not required to give up your current nationality, and the government maintains strict confidentiality regarding all citizenship applications without notifying your home country.
stlucia.faqQ11: Are there any language, education, or work history tests?
stlucia.faqA10: Saint Lucia offers an advantageous fiscal regime with no capital gains, inheritance, gift, or worldwide wealth taxes. Non-residents enjoy zero taxation on foreign-sourced income, providing an ideal structure for global asset protection and tax planning.
stlucia.faqQ12: How many countries can I travel to visa-free with a Saint Lucia passport?
stlucia.faqA11: No, there are no mandatory language proficiency tests, interviews on local history or culture, educational degree requirements, or business management experience required to qualify for citizenship by investment.
stlucia.faqQ13: At what stage in the process do I transfer my main investment funds?
stlucia.faqA12: A Saint Lucia passport grants visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry to over 140 destinations worldwide. Key regions include the UK, European Schengen Area countries, Singapore, Hong Kong, and major business hubs across the Americas and Caribbean.
stlucia.faqQ14: Is an online interview mandatory for Saint Lucia applicants?
stlucia.faqA13: You are only required to transfer the primary qualifying investment amount AFTER your application has successfully passed government due diligence and received an official approval-in-principle letter from the Citizenship Unit.
stlucia.faqQ15: Can I apply directly to the government without an agent?
stlucia.faqA14: Yes, as part of enhanced Caribbean due diligence standards, a virtual online interview and identity verification check are mandatory for the main applicant and all qualifying dependants aged 16 and older before final approval is granted.
stlucia.faqQ16: What are the statutory due diligence and processing fees?
stlucia.faqA15: No, Saint Lucia sovereign law mandates that all citizenship applications must be submitted through an officially licensed Authorised Agent. Sharif Group guides you through file preparation, pre-screening, notarization, and official submission.
stlucia.faqQ17: How long is the Saint Lucia passport valid and how is it renewed?
stlucia.faqA16: Government processing fees are $2,000 USD for the main applicant and $1,000 USD per dependant. Statutory due diligence background check fees are $8,000 USD for the main applicant and $5,000 USD for each dependant over 16 years of age.
stlucia.faqQ18: Can my citizenship be passed down to future children?
stlucia.faqA17: Saint Lucia passports are issued with a 5-year validity period for all adults and children. Passport renewals are a straightforward administrative procedure that can be facilitated through our Dubai office or any official Saint Lucia consulate without needing to re-invest.
stlucia.faqQ19: What basic documents do I need to start my application?
stlucia.faqA18: Yes, Saint Lucia citizenship is irrevocable, permanent, and hereditary. Newborn children born after citizenship is granted can inherit citizenship by descent, providing long-term security across generations for your entire family line.
stlucia.faqQ20: Why choose Sharif Group for my Saint Lucia application?
stlucia.faqA19: Initial requirements include certified color copies of valid passports, national IDs, original birth certificates, clean police clearance certificates from all residence countries over the past 10 years, 12 months of bank statements, and proof of legal source of funds.

vanuatu.faqQ2: How fast can I get a Vanuatu passport?
vanuatu.faqA1: Vanuatu offers one of the fastest passport processing times globally. The entire application timeline typically takes between 2 to 3 months from initial document submission to passport pickup.
vanuatu.faqQ3: Do I need to visit or live in Vanuatu?
vanuatu.faqA2: No, Vanuatu has zero physical residency or travel requirements. You can complete the entire application process remotely from our Business Bay office in Dubai without visiting the islands.
vanuatu.faqQ4: What family members can be included in my application?
vanuatu.faqA3: You can include your legal spouse, dependent children under 18, unmarried full-time student children aged 18 to 25, and dependent parents aged 55 and above in a single combined submission.
vanuatu.faqQ5: What is the Development Support Program (DSP)?
vanuatu.faqA4: The DSP is an official, government-backed citizenship program created to raise capital for local infrastructure projects and economic growth in exchange for honorary citizenship and passport issuance.
vanuatu.faqQ6: What is the Capital Investment Immigration Plan (CIIP)?
vanuatu.faqA5: The CIIP is an alternative investment track under Form D guidelines that focuses on green energy initiatives, sustainable agriculture, and specialized local development projects starting from $260,000 USD for families.
vanuatu.faqA6: Yes, dual citizenship is fully recognized and legal in Vanuatu. You do not need to give up your primary nationality, and your application details remain strictly private and confidential.
vanuatu.faqQ8: What are the main tax advantages of Vanuatu citizenship?
vanuatu.faqA7: Vanuatu is a world-renowned tax haven. Citizens enjoy 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% estate tax, 0% wealth tax, and no taxes on foreign income or offshore corporate profits.
vanuatu.faqQ9: How many countries can I visit visa-free?
vanuatu.faqA8: A Vanuatu passport provides visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry to 96+ countries worldwide, including major hubs across Asia, Africa, the Americas, and the Oceania region.
vanuatu.faqQ10: What are the FIU background check fees?
vanuatu.faqA9: The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) due diligence screening fee is fixed at $5,000 USD per application file to conduct security checks before initial approval is granted.
vanuatu.faqQ11: Are there language tests or educational requirements?
vanuatu.faqA10: No, Vanuatu citizenship has no language tests, business management experience rules, or mandatory education requirements. Qualifications are based on passing background screening and financial proof.
vanuatu.faqQ12: How long is my Vanuatu passport valid for?
vanuatu.faqA11: Vanuatu passports for adult applicants (18+) are issued with an initial validity of 5 years, which can easily be renewed for 10-year extensions through our Dubai office.
vanuatu.faqQ13: When do I make the main investment payment?
vanuatu.faqA12: You only transfer the main contribution donation after receiving official approval in principle from the Vanuatu Citizenship Commission, ensuring your capital remains completely safe.
vanuatu.faqQ14: How do I take the Oath of Allegiance?
vanuatu.faqA13: The Oath of Allegiance can be taken via a video call or in person in front of a Vanuatu Commissioner of Oaths or Magistrate, which can be arranged through our Dubai office.
vanuatu.faqQ15: Can I submit my application directly to the government?
vanuatu.faqA14: No, the Vanuatu Citizenship Office requires all investor citizenship files to be submitted through government-recognized designated representatives and accredited advisory agencies like Sharif Group.
vanuatu.faqQ16: Can future children inherit my Vanuatu citizenship?
vanuatu.faqA15: Yes, citizenship granted by Vanuatu is lifelong and legally hereditary, allowing you to pass down citizenship rights to future newborn children through standard registration procedures.
vanuatu.faqQ17: What primary documents are needed to apply?
vanuatu.faqA16: Basic required paperwork includes certified passport color copies, birth certificates, police clearance records, bank statements for the past 12 months, professional reference letters, and medical health test results.
vanuatu.faqQ18: Can I open an international bank account with a Vanuatu passport?
vanuatu.faqA17: Yes, holding a second passport from Vanuatu makes it easier to establish offshore corporate entities, diversify financial assets, and open international bank accounts across top financial hubs.
vanuatu.faqQ19: Are there any restrictions on current nationality?
vanuatu.faqA18: Vanuatu accepts applicants from most global nationalities. However, citizens of a few restricted countries may require additional residency or background checks. Contact our Dubai team to check your nationality eligibility.

saotome.faqQ3: Do I need to visit or live in São Tomé & Príncipe?
saotome.faqA2: No, there are zero physical residency or travel requirements before, during, or after your citizenship is granted. The entire process can be completed remotely from Dubai.
saotome.faqQ4: What is the National Transformation Fund (NTF)?
saotome.faqA3: The NTF is a government-managed economic fund designed to finance national development projects, public infrastructure, education, and local growth in São Tomé & Príncipe.
saotome.faqQ5: Which family members can I include in my application?
saotome.faqA4: You can include your legally married spouse, financially dependent children up to 30 years of age, and dependent parents or grandparents aged 55 and above in a single file.
saotome.faqQ6: Does São Tomé & Príncipe allow dual citizenship?
saotome.faqA5: Yes, dual citizenship is fully recognized and permitted under national law. You do not need to give up your current nationality, and your home government is not informed.
saotome.faqQ7: What government fees apply in addition to the donation?
saotome.faqA6: Each application requires a flat submission and due diligence fee of $5,000 USD, plus $750 USD per applicant to cover registration certificates, passports, and national IDs.
saotome.faqQ8: Can I add family members after receiving approval?
saotome.faqA7: Yes, post-approval family additions are supported with flexible rules, allowing you to easily add new spouses, additional dependents, or newborn children ($500 USD fee) later on.
saotome.faqQ9: Are there any language tests or educational rules?
saotome.faqA8: No, the program does not require any language proficiency exams, local history tests, formal interviews, or minimum educational qualifications to be approved.
saotome.faqQ10: What are the main tax benefits available?
saotome.faqA9: São Tomé & Príncipe offers a business-friendly tax system with no personal income tax on foreign earnings, making it an excellent base for international investors.
saotome.faqQ11: How many countries can I visit visa-free?
saotome.faqA10: A São Tomé & Príncipe passport provides visa-free, visa-on-arrival, or e-visa access to nearly 100 destinations worldwide, including key regional business hubs.
saotome.faqQ12: When do I pay the primary investment contribution?
saotome.faqA11: You only transfer the main National Transformation Fund contribution after your application has been officially vetted and granted formal government approval.
saotome.faqQ13: What background checks are conducted on applicants?
saotome.faqA12: The government carries out due diligence screening to confirm that all adult applicants have a clean police record and a legitimate, verifiable source of funds.
saotome.faqQ14: Can I apply directly without a licensed agency?
saotome.faqA13: No, government guidelines state that all citizenship applications must be submitted through licensed and authorized processing agencies like Sharif Group.
saotome.faqQ15: What identity documents are needed to start?
saotome.faqA14: To begin, you will need certified passport copies, full birth certificates, recent white-background passport photos, national ID cards, and a police clearance certificate.
saotome.faqQ16: How lenient is the financial proof policy?
saotome.faqA15: São Tomé & Príncipe has a lenient policy that accepts basic income proof, such as an employment letter or bank reference, rather than multi-year corporate tax audits.
saotome.faqQ17: What health records must be provided?
saotome.faqA16: Adult applicants must submit a medical certificate signed by a licensed physician confirming general good health and freedom from serious contagious diseases.
saotome.faqQ18: How long is the passport valid before renewal?
saotome.faqA17: Passports are issued with standard validity periods and can be conveniently renewed through our Sharif Group Dubai office or local diplomatic missions.
saotome.faqQ19: Can citizenship be passed down to future generations?
saotome.faqA18: Yes, citizenship is permanent for life and can be legally inherited by your newborn children and future generations through standard registration.

portugal.faqA9: Holders enjoy complete visa-free travel mobility across all 29 European member countries belonging to the Schengen Area without extra border paperwork.

portugal.faqA11: Yes. Sharif Group manages your documentation pre-vetting, NIF setup, and fund alignment entirely from our Business Bay office. Travel to Portugal is only needed later for biometrics.
portugal.faqA12: These are collective investment funds or private equity vehicles supervised by the Portuguese Securities Market Commission (CMVM), designed to back corporate growth and business assets.
portugal.faqA13: You will need valid passports, birth certificates, clean police clearance certificates, medical declarations, proof of address, and financial source of funds documents.

portugal.faqA15: Yes. Portuguese law permits dual citizenship, meaning you do not have to give up your original nationality when obtaining your Portuguese passport.
portugal.faqA16: Unless you choose to become a full tax resident by staying more than 183 days a year, holding a Golden Visa does not automatically make you subject to worldwide taxation in Portugal.
